description: This file contains gradient registration and implementations for specific TensorFlow data flow operations such as DynamicPartition and DynamicStitch, including their gradient computation functions. It also includes registration calls to associate gradients with corresponding operations.

methods.name: absl::Status DynamicPartitionGrad(const Scope & scope,const Operation & op,const std::vector<Output> & grad_inputs,std::vector<Output> * grad_outputs)
methods.description: Computes the gradient for the DynamicPartition operation by mapping incoming gradients back to the original data inputs.

methods.name: absl::Status DynamicStitchGrad(const Scope & scope,const Operation & op,const std::vector<Output> & grad_inputs,std::vector<Output> * grad_outputs)
methods.description: Computes the gradient for the DynamicStitch operation by distributing gradients according to the indices used in the forward pass.
